name: Framework Module
description: An AbstractModule subclass that groups related Registrable classes for the framework's Loader. The wp/cpt, wp/taxonomy, wp/cli and other scaffolds wire their generated classes into a module of the matching kind.

inputs.description: PSR-4 namespace for the module class. Default 'Inc\Modules' matches the rtCamp skeleton.
Directory for the module file. Default 'includes/Modules'.
PSR-4 namespace for the test class. Default 'Inc\Tests\Modules'.
Directory for the test file. Default 'tests/Modules'.
Logical module name, e.g. 'PostTypes', 'Taxonomies', 'Blocks'. Normalised to a PascalCase class name, so 'post-types' and 'PostTypes' both yield class PostTypes.
PascalCase class name, derived from name.

Scaffold kind this module hosts. One of: cpt, taxonomy, block-dynamic, shortcode, admin-page, settings-page, user-role, rest, cron, registrable, cli. Determines the anchor inserted into get_classes() so the matching add scaffold can wire into it.

wiring.description: Add this module to the plugin's top-level Loader list so the framework instantiates it on boot. If Plugin.php does not yet declare a Loader, instantiate the generated module manually in your plugin bootstrap and call its register_hooks() method.
